title.narrative: Power Sector Reforms and Financial Sustainability Program (Subprogram 2)

description.narrative: The principal objective of the Programmatic Approach is to establish the independence and financial sustainability of electricity utilities and streamline and accelerate the development of renewable energy sources. The Programmatic Approach comprises three subprograms and the Program is the second subprogram. The Program scope includes reforms to (i) the institutional structure of the power sector; (ii) the tariff structure with a view to making tariffs cost reflective; and (iii) renewable energy development and related procurement processes. The Program is described in more detail in the Policy Letter and the PDF.

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Dec 30, 2022 - May 31, 2024

description.narrative:
Action 1: Cabinet approved a bill (Electricity Bill), clearly separating the policy making and regulatory functions from operational functions in the sector and ensuring independence of each of these functions without any overlapping functions, authority, or responsibilities. Base year: 2024 Base value: N Target date: 2024-05-31 Target value: Y
Action 2: The CEB, as the bulk purchaser and seller of electricity, established the BSTA as a separate account and published its transactions monthly to facilitate regular monitoring of deviations from the forecast bulk supply costs. Action 3: The CEB approved and submitted to PUCSL the proposal on the reduction of distribution losses based on recommendations from the loss reduction study to use for tariff submissions. Base year: 2024 Base value: N Target date: 2024-05-31 Target value: Y
Action 4: The CEB and LECO, in 2023, started the implementation of annual programs for women's empowerment based on the WePOWER initiative SLSEA obtained membership of WePOWER initiative and the Sri Lanka WePOWER National Chapter and commenced implementing similar programs. Base year: 2024 Base value: N Target date: 2024-05-31 Target value: Y
Action 1: To enable a more structured and less disruptive transition, Parliament passed the amendments to the Electricity Act 2024, and MOE submitted to the Minister for approval the preliminary transfer plan for the unbundling of the CEB into independent successor companies for undertaking generation, transmission, power system operations and bulk supply, and distribution functions. Base year: 2024 Base value: N Target date: 2025-09-30 Target value: Y

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Jun 28, 2024 - Sep 30, 2025

description.narrative:
Policy 1: Reform Area 1: Institutional structural reform of sector entities implemented (Ceylon Electricity Board and Lanka Electricity Company Pvt Ltd.) Outcome 1: Successor companies of the CEB for generation, transmission, NSO, and distribution are established and operate as independent companies by 2026. (Baseline 2024: no corporatization, except LECO) (DR 11) (source: MOE and successor companies reports)
Action 2: MOE in coordination with (i) the committees responsible for the CEB's generation (regarding the CEB successor generation company) and NSO functions (regarding the CEB successor NSO company) within PSRS concluded the draft PPAs, and (ii) the committees responsible for the CEB's NSO (regarding the CEB successor NSO company) and distribution functions (regarding the CEB successor distribution company and LECO) within PSRS concluded the draft PSAs for bulk power transactions. Base year: 2024 Base value: N Target date: 2025-09-30 Target value: Y
Action 3: MOE in coordination with the committees at PSRS (regarding the CEB successor companies and LECO) prepared and submitted to PUCSL for approval the revised Grid Code and Distribution Code, which the NSO will adopt and implement with revised guidelines and processes, in line with the regulations, for generation, transmission and distribution planning and procurement. Base year: 2024 Base value: N Target date: 2025-09-30 Target value: Y
Action 4: Energy sector agencies (the CEB, LECO, and SLSEA) implemented women leadership programs on an annual basis and began providing training, conducted by female mentors, to female staff to enhance leadership skills, technical competencies, industry knowledge, and career development. Base year: 2024 Base value: N Target date: 2025-09-30 Target value: Y
Action 5: Energy sector agencies (the CEB, LECO, and SLSEA) approved a gender inclusive policy and implemented strategies that encompass the adoption of inclusive practices and the integration of gender equality considerations into their decision-making processes. Base year: 2024 Base value: N Target date: 2025-09-30 Target value: Y
Action 1: Cabinet will approve the preliminary transfer plan, and the successor companies of the CEB for generation, transmission, NSO, and distribution functions will commence their operations as independent companies following corporatization under the Companies Act No. 7 of 2007 and being granted operating licenses. Base year: 2024 Base value: N Target date: 2026-09-30 Target value: Y
